_comment: Frostpeak Caldera terrain: a copy of the base 'mountain' generator (FRACTAL_SMOKE cone, wide BILINEAR_STARCAST_9 interpolation) but terraced via cliffHeight* so the cone reads as LAYERED mesa-like shelves instead of a single noisy slope. We do NOT edit base 'mountain' (it is shared by other biomes); the caldera child points at this dedicated generator. The CELLULAR_HEIGHT generator quantises the cone's height into broad flat steps separated by sharp cliffs, matching the mesa look of the parent plateau.
